content: (3) Comparing with conventional RC models, AutoJudge achieves significant improvement with the consideration of additional law articles. It reflects the difference between LRC and conventional RC models. We re-formalize LRC in legal area to incorporate law articles via the reading mechanism, which can enhance judgment prediction. Moreover, CNN/GRU+law decrease the performance by simply concatenating original text with law articles, while GRU+Attention/AutoJudge increase the performance by integrating law articles with attention mechanism. It shows the importance and rationality of using attention mechanism to capture the interaction between multiple inputs.
